snippet.title: Rogue ’n’ Roll: Dice of Fate – Official Gameplay Trailer | Dice Roguelike
snippet.description:
Rogue ’n’ Roll is a fast-paced dice-based roguelike where every roll can change your fate.

Manipulate powerful dice, discover relics with unique effects, and create insane synergies to defeat dangerous enemies in a dark pixel-art dungeon.

🔥 Features:
• Unique dice combat system
• Dozens of powerful relics
• Strategic risk-vs-reward gameplay
• Endless build combinations
• Dark atmospheric pixel art

Every run is different.
Every roll matters.

Will you master the dice… or will the dungeon claim you?

🎲 Wishlist Rogue ’n’ Roll on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3760520/Rogue_n_Roll_Dice_of_Fate/

Follow the development and stay updated here!
